invariants_checked: Dimension 1 (Multi-Tenant, Cross-Workspace, and API-Key Isolation): Audited all 71 upstream-changed files in internal/application/** line-by-line across both merge and upstream diffs. Verified access/message_files.go bounds session message attachment lookups by session_id + tenant_id; shared-KB data analysis storage resolution (knowledge.go, shared_kb_data_analysis_storage_test.go) resolves the KB owner workspace storage backend; agent_service.go MCP selection normalizes MCPSelectionMode and fails closed on empty, none, or unrecognized modes without enumerating tenant MCP services; datasource_service.go enforces caller tenant/API-key authorization, payload/syncLog/ds tenant & DataSourceID consistency, and suspended/deleted workspace blocking; knowledge finalizer/passage sync/rerank revision/search result slot paths preserve tenant_id and KB read/write grants; wiki_page.go and wiki_ingest*.go scope wiki pages, snapshots, links, backlinks, search, and live-knowledge checks by (tenant_id, knowledge_base_id); neo4j/repository.go scopes Entity/Relation/Chunk/Document graph deletes by Workspace label; and weaviate/repository.go scopes vector queries/deletes by tenant_id filter while preserving source_type/source_id identity.

Dimension 2 (State Machine and Rollback Correctness): Verified multimodal_pending_counter.go (Redis + Lite in-memory generation-fenced counters), knowledge_finalizer_attempt_test.go / repository/knowledge.go attempt-fenced MarkKnowledgeCompletedIfFinalizing CAS, knowledge_post_process.go / knowledge_process.go subtask slot release on retry/reparse/cancel/failure, datasource_service.go cancel/pause/replay/ingest state transitions (preserving terminal success/partial SyncLog rows on redelivery and returning cancelSyncLog DB errors for Asynq retry), evaluation.go cleanup without stranding tasks, temporary_document*.go storage/SQL/vector rollback on parser error or expiration, session_knowledge_qa.go truncation/fallback stream handling, and chat_pipeline/{chat_completion_stream,citation_sources}.go stream lifecycle and citation source population.

Dimension 3 (Concurrency Races, Streaming Memory Bounds, and SSRF): Verified mutex/atomic/Redis/Lite-mode concurrency safety under go test -race across all modified packages, bounded reads and objectStorageBoundReader / SafeObjectKey / SSRF endpoint + virtual-hosted bucket authority validation in service/file/obs.go, size-bounded document/image reads in temporary_document_parse.go and image_multimodal.go, bounded sync error slices in datasource_service.go, and optimistic-lock snapshot fencing (WithWikiPageWriteSnapshot) + table-row loss guards in repository/wiki_page.go and service/wiki_ingest_batch.go.

Dimension 4 (Contracts and GENYEE Alignment): Preserved all exported Go function/method/type signatures across internal/application/**; verified zero legacy upstream brand or key-prefix residues, zero hardcoded host paths, and 4/4 PASS on scripts/verify-commercial-compliance.sh --tier 5.

findings.summary: registerMCPTools changed empty MCPSelectionMode to default to 'none', but kept an open else branch calling ListMCPServices(ctx, tenantID) for anything other than literal 'none' or 'selected'. Unnormalized ('NONE', ' none ', ' Selected ') or unrecognized ('disabled', 'off', etc. via custom-agent creation or YAML import) MCPSelectionMode values bypassed 'none' and failed open, exposing all enabled workspace MCP tools to the agent.
findings.fix: Normalized MCPSelectionMode with strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(...)) and switched explicitly on '', 'none' (no-op), 'selected' (ListMCPServicesByIDs when non-empty), and 'all' (ListMCPServices), failing closed with a warning on any unrecognized mode.

findings.summary: In DataSourceService.ProcessSync, the unavailable/suspended-workspace guard ignored syncLogRepo.Update errors and returned nil (allowing Asynq to acknowledge a SyncLog stuck in 'running' on transient DB failure), and both the unavailable-workspace and deleted-KB branches lacked the terminalResult ('success'/'partial') replay guard used by sourceMissing, overwriting finished SyncLogs to 'canceled' on redelivery.
findings.fix: Added terminalResult early-return preservation before cancelling on both unavailable-workspace and deleted-KB paths, and routed unavailable-workspace cancellation through s.cancelSyncLog so DB write errors return for Asynq retry.

findings.summary: wikiIngestService.isKnowledgeGone used unscoped GetKnowledgeByIDOnly without checking kn.TenantID or kn.KnowledgeBaseID, and mapOneDocument read kn.Title without tenant/KB verification. A document moved to another KB while wiki ingest was queued or mid-reduce (especially in Lite mode without Redis tombstones) or a foreign-tenant knowledge ID would be treated as live, leaking source titles/updates across KB or tenant boundaries.
findings.fix: Enforced tenant_id and knowledge_base_id ownership checks in wikiIngestService.isKnowledgeGone, propagated payload/batch tenantID into context in mapOneDocument and reduceSlugUpdates when absent, and guarded mapOneDocument's kn.Title lookup by payload TenantID and KnowledgeBaseID.

findings.summary: Upstream virtual-hosted OBS addressing ({bucket}.{endpointHost}) interpolated bucketName directly into outgoing S3/OBS hostnames and GetFileURL URLs without validating DNS label syntax (allowing userinfo, port, path/fragment delimiters, or IP literals), and obsFileService.SaveBytes omitted utils.SafeObjectKey validation unlike SaveFile and CopyFile.
findings.fix: Added validateOBSBucketName enforcing non-empty <=63-char non-IP DNS bucket labels across NewObsFileService, CheckObsConnectivity, and GetFileURL, and enforced utils.SafeObjectKey(objectKey) in SaveBytes prior to PutObject.
